annotations.title: Write a design brief from chosen terms

description: Builds a precise design brief (markdown) from Lingo term ids and/or vague phrases, ready to paste into an AI coding agent or a project rules file. Conflicting picks (for example sharp and soft corners) keep the last one. Includes optional "don't look AI-made" rules and a link that opens the brief in Lingo.

avoid_ai_look.description: Add rules that steer away from the generic AI-made look. Default true.

say.description: Optional vague request to decode and include, e.g. "more premium".

terms.description: Term ids from the terms tool, e.g. ["airy","display","accent","soft"]. In a GET query use a comma-separated list.
